Thanks Morgan — here is a concise end-to-end validation plan and checklist for Alex and Riley.  
Test scenarios (for Alex): run (a) new-user signup → first-successful-action, (b) returning-user multi-step funnel with feature toggle variations, and (c) error/retry paths; for each record timestamps, user_id, session_id, event order, and any property differences.

Dashboards/queries for Riley: validate demo dashboards and these explorer queries for DAU/WAU, funnel conversion for the demo flow, average time-to-complete, and error rate; acceptance = metrics match synthetic expectations within ±3% and no missing/null keys or out-of-order timestamps.

Riley — blocking if outside ±3%: funnel conversion for the demo flow, event counts (loss/duplicates), and error/failed-event rate; informational (document variance and proceed): average time-to-complete and secondary segment breakdowns.
